extracted.intended_audience: improv performers and theater audiences (people interested in musical improv shows/festivals)
extracted.subtask_description: Stand-up of rules/expectations for musical improv festival shows: includes a competitive short-form improv match (teams, referee, points) and long-form musical improv created from audience suggestions. Describes performance style, audience participation, and improvisational requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speed and humor
rubrics_metrics.description: the fastest and funniest form of improv comedy in the Big Apple.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectation that performances emphasize rapid-fire pacing and high comedic energy; marketed as both very fast and very funny.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competitive two-team format with scoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Two teams of improvisers vie for points in a hilarious competition by playing a series of improv games, similar to what you may have seen on TV's Whose Line Is It Anyway?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows are structured as matches between two teams; success is measured via points earned through improv games; format modeled on short-form televised improv competitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referee governance and pacing
rubrics_metrics.description: A referee governs the action, calling fouls and keeping the match moving at a blistering pace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A referee enforces rules, calls fouls, and ensures rapid momentum; maintaining brisk pace and rule-enforced structure is part of the show's expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience interactivity and volunteer involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: The audience is always a part of the interactive show, and audience volunteers sometimes even wind up on stage!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience members are expected to participate (e.g., giving suggestions, volunteering onstage); interaction is integral to the format and can influence content/direction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-form musical created from audience suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: BEEES!!! spontaneously creates a long-form musical based on an audience member's suggestion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long-form structure must be derived from an audience prompt; performers must translate a single suggestion into an extended musical narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete improvisation of songs, lines, and movement
rubrics_metrics.description: Every song, line and hip gyration is improvised on the spot
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No prewritten lyrics, dialogue, or choreography are used — all musical and physical elements are invented in the moment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylistic tone: melodrama and complex relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: BEEES!!! brings you to a world full of melodrama, complex relationships, and fun times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performances aim for heightened, melodramatic storytelling with layered interpersonal dynamics while maintaining comedic enjoyment.
